deck.caption:
Saudi Arabia just hired the executive behind a $21.9B hospital IPO to restructure its entire national healthcare system for 33 million citizens. 🚨

Retail investors are treating this headline as an immediate green light for healthcare equities. But institutional money knows better.

Here is what happens behind the scenes when sovereign megaprojects take over public infrastructure:

1️⃣ CapEx Spikes: Infrastructure for 33M people demands immediate, massive capital expenditure.
2️⃣ Margin Compression: Government mandates enforce regulatory price controls, limiting short-term profit margins.
3️⃣ ROIC Drag: Return on Invested Capital takes years to recover during multi-phase transitions.

Never chase healthcare equities based on headline deal numbers or high-profile appointments alone.
